scene.observation_budget: entire supplied recording observed-static union; same observer/world/split only; dynamics current frame
scene.coordinate_protocol: persistent world map; transform to current window anchor at query
scene.evaluation_input_scope: supplied recording only; restricted benchmark clips must use a restricted observation manifest

feedback.position_protocol: root translation and SO3 FK, fixed bone lengths

validation.scope: 100 fixed EXO VAL windows for best +100 rotating EXO VAL windows for monitoring; separate fixed head-only EGO retention anchors; both clean/noisy. VALIDATION quotas follow its own eligible-window proportions.

config.exo_window_policy: at least one observed joint; maximum 18 consecutive all-joint-missing raw30 frames; partial joint occlusion retained; full static recording memory unchanged

reference_input.coordinate_frame: same fixed window world coordinates as scene and observed tracks
reference_input.fallback: observed-track kinematic initializer with supplied rest bones; no GT motion
reference_input.occluded_prior: retain full estimated motion; encode low position/rotation confidence
reference_input.availability: real video frontend predictions are not yet in current dataset cache

refinement.placement: predicted proposal and final x0 within diffusion
refinement.exo: confidence/uncertainty weighted observed torso rigid pose
refinement.ego: head position translation only; no camera-to-body heading constraint
refinement.joint_anchor_schedule: cosine alpha; skip alpha<0.05; predicted proposal and final x0; root excluded

scene_relations.input_policy: predicted body and trusted tracks only; broad upward samples are context, not completed surfaces

physical_guidance.acceptance: joint physical/observation/prior energy decreases and trusted measurements protected
physical_guidance.placement: every clean x0 before next DDIM update; shallow observed support only

sampler.windows: Global eligible TRAIN EXO windows: shuffle once per epoch; no replacement before every eligible window is visited; preserve RNG and cursor on resume.

runtime.protocol: canonical geometry and GT supervision then shared rigid yaw; same protocol as prior pilot
runtime.cache_location: E drive adjacent to raw30 cache
runtime.unchanged: Original nativeL192 FP32, body/rest/observation/noise/scene/IK/losses; analytical physicsOFF. Only fresh adapter optimization horizon, natural window sampler, and wider fixed+rotating VAL selection change.

phase_plan.initialization: Fresh zero-output EXO internal LoRA over the selected original41k+3000 control; new AdamW and complete cosine10000; do not resume or load the 1000-step adapter.
phase_plan.next_phase: Finish at 10000. Select best on fixed VAL only. No automatic extra training or TEST-driven tuning.
phase_plan.checkpoint_policy: Atomic full resumable last every100; complete 2k/4k/6k/8k/10k checkpoints and full best by fixed VAL, hardlinks for identical bytes.

acceptance.scope: Fixed/rotating development VAL only. Best selection is separate from scientific acceptance; no TEST-driven selection.
acceptance.ego: Same inputs/seeds selected control and final EGO predictions exactly equal; frozen control tensor hash unchanged.
acceptance.exo_hidden: Report per-corpus and equal-corpus diagnostic versus selected control and repaired input reference; retain original strict >=5% relative hidden improvement requirement as a separate acceptance decision, not an automatic property of best.
acceptance.exo_visible: Each dataset/regime count-weighted conditioned MPJPE final<=baseline+max(1mm,2%). Per-window changes reported independently; no claim allwindows improve.
acceptance.body_and_motion: Each dataset/regime GT-low-speed foot3Dspeed<=baseline+max(0.01m/s,5%); bilateral motionRMSerror and6/12-frame strideerror windowmeans<=baseline+max(5mm,10%). Report rooterror. These do not certify absence of floating or fullmesh collision.
acceptance.best_selection: Best available among 2k/4k/6k/8k/10k milestones by fixed100 hidden-window MPJPE with natural VAL corpus weights, clean/noisy equally weighted. Rotating100 and probes excluded.
acceptance.temporal: Report full-body velocity/acceleration and wrist/arm rotation timing where available. Old wrist case retained as a separate probe; a lower position error alone does not establish jitter is solved.

adaptation.scale_policy: diagnose only; same metric rest/body_scale andscene units; no GT-aligned outputs used foracceptance

selection: All12 RICH fixed identities, first4 distinct TRUMANS/EgoBody recordings in sealed fixed ordering; no error/GT selection. One predeclared EGO anchor per corpus.
aggregation: Equal window within dataset, report each regime and scene separately; macro three datasets equally weighted. Window P90 is not joint-sample P90.
acceptance: Compare candidate vs base10k and paired control; hidden mean/P90 and reference-worse>=50mm, visible, stance-foot speed and acceleration must be reviewed; no automatic promotion
